Read `gh issue view 7213 -R learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io` — if `gh` is unavailable in the worktree, the
issue context is: burn down `scripts/ci/subprocess_timeout_allowlist.txt` by directory slice, following the merged
pattern of slices 1–3 (#7214 `scripts/ci/`, #7215 `scripts/api/`, #7217 `scripts/ai_agent_bridge/`): a named
module-level constant per bound class, `TimeoutExpired` mapped onto the site's EXISTING failure semantics, one test per
site exercising the real code path with a monkeypatched `TimeoutExpired`.

This slice covers ONLY allowlist entries whose path is `scripts/delegate.py` (32 entries) or
`scripts/verify_review.py` (1 entry). This is the dispatch layer — the silent-stall class the burn-down was
prioritized for: a hung git/gh child inside `delegate.py` stalls a fleet dispatch invisibly.

## Outcome
Every `scripts/delegate.py` and `scripts/verify_review.py` allowlist entry is either fixed (bounded, removed from the
allowlist) or explicitly skipped with a one-line reason in the PR body. No other directories, no other files.

## Rules for values
- Grep `timeout=` in `scripts/delegate.py` FIRST and reuse its existing timeout constants/conventions where present
  (the module already has silence/hard-timeout machinery — do not invent a parallel convention).
- The 32 delegate.py sites are almost all LOCAL git plumbing (`status`, `rev-parse`, `worktree list`, `branch`,
  `fetch`, `push`, PR creation): local-only git commands get tens of seconds; anything that can touch the network
  (`fetch`, `push`, `gh pr create` in the auto-finalize path) gets minutes — one constant per class, not per site.
- Map `TimeoutExpired` onto each site's existing failure semantics (many helpers return None/False or raise a typed
  dispatch error — keep exactly that shape; say in the PR table which shape each site keeps).
- DO NOT change: dispatch stdout contract (`<task_id>\n<run_nonce>`), run-nonce logic, sweep behavior, retry logic,
  exit codes, message formats, read-only guard semantics, ownership/path-overlap admission. Only add bounds + the
  `TimeoutExpired` mapping.

## Coordination
No entry in this slice is session-handoff/session-handling code, but if you find an edit would touch
`session_streams`, `rollover`, `thread_handoff`, or `claudex` imports, SKIP that site with reason
"owned by session-handling lane" and list it.
